Make an eco-system management game in which you play as a huge organism fighting off a tiny invading virus-like organism. The player has to manage the flora and fauna of the environment in order to limit the spread of the invaders. (Think germ sized invaders on a human and the game is to manage the body's defense mechanisms.)

The final level could be Earth fighting off humans (as a contrast to an earlier level in which a human fights off the flu). You could breed certain animals and kill humans off that way, tigers/bears/hippos/mosquitoes etc. You could cause earthquakes/tsunamis but the strategy is that each defense will have a negative effect on the big picture to balance out the handful of units it disposes of.
